The Stay

A promise, kept every morning

It's the sunrise that first draws guests to Palmetto Promise, but it's the unhurried pace of island life that keeps them here.

There is something about a Hilton Head winter that slows everything down. The beaches are wide and quiet, the air is mild and salty, and the only schedule is the one the tide keeps. Mornings begin on your private balcony, coffee warm in your hands, as the sky turns from ink to peach and the waves keep their rhythm below… and if you're lucky, dolphins roll past, just as one guest watched a whole pod do from this very spot.

When you're ready, it's a short ride down the elevator and a 3-minute stroll along the boardwalk, through whispering dune grasses, until the sand gives way beneath your feet.

There is no breakfast that can't be made in the fully equipped kitchen, from a slow Sunday pancake stack to a quick cup from the Keurig before a sunrise walk.

Days like these are best shared with the people you love. Come back salty and sun-warmed, gather on the couch for a movie or a video call with the grandkids, and let the evening drift by on the balcony with something cold in your glass and the ocean breeze on your face.

Palmetto Promise is a snug nest of about 500 square feet, and we'd rather tell you up front: it's perfect for a couple or a small family, and cozy beyond that.

Why Guests Stay

Small condo, big perks

This cozy retreat wouldn't be complete without the little comforts that turn a winter away into one long, slow exhale.

Sunrise balcony

There is no better seat on the island for sunrise. The Atlantic turns gold while your coffee steams, palms rustle below and the surf keeps its slow, steady rhythm.

Beach day, already packed

Everything you need for a perfect beach day is already waiting: chairs, umbrella, towels, sand toys, a boogie board and a wagon to carry it all three minutes to the sand.

Two pools, all year

Spend a lazy afternoon by the big beachside pool, or slip away to the quieter pool tucked in the pines. Both are open year-round, though not heated, so winter dips are bracing. There's no hot tub.

Free pickleball and tennis

Nothing beats the satisfying pop of a paddle under the trees. Courts are free for guests; just reserve a time at the main desk, then cool down in the resort gym.

Fiber Wi-Fi and two TVs

On a rainy afternoon, there's nothing cozier than curling up with a movie on the 55-inch TV. Video calls home stay crisp on 1 Gbps fiber, so nobody misses the grandkids.

Laundry on your floor

Sandy towels never pile up here. The laundry room is just down the hall, paid with the free CleanPay app, and the elevator means no hauling bags up the stairs.

Amenities

All set for a long stay

No extended stay would be complete without the comforts of home… and a few resort extras you'd never find there. One honest note: there's no dishwasher.

Sleeping Arrangements

Where everyone sleeps

About 500 square feet, one bedroom and one full bath. It's sweetest for 2 adults and 2 kids, and even that is cozy; it sleeps up to 6, but six is cramped. We'd rather tell you now than surprise you at check-in.

Bedroom

Queen bedroom

Sink into crisp white linens and a plush throw while the ceiling fan turns slowly overhead. Your own smart TV, closet and dresser make this the quiet retreat at day's end.

Bunk nook

Twin bunk beds

Porthole accents and nautical bedding turn bedtime into a night in a ship's cabin. Built for kids or shorter adults; taller guests will find them snug.

Living room

Sleeper sofa

By day it's where everyone piles in for popcorn and a movie; by night it opens onto a new 4-inch memory foam mattress. It's in the living room, which is why six guests feels cramped.

Around the Island

Beyond the boardwalk

The experience of island life wouldn't be complete without exploring it. Pedal shaded bike paths, hop the free trolley outside the gate or chase a day trip when the island calls. Times are approximate.

10-25 Minutes Away

Island Beach Parks

Spread a towel under a shady pavilion, rinse the salt off at the outdoor showers and pick a fresh stretch of shoreline to wander.

About 20 Minutes Away

Pinckney Island Wildlife Refuge

Walk quiet marsh trails at first light, where egrets stand still as statues and the air smells of salt and pluff mud.

About 30 Minutes Away

Harbour Town Lighthouse

Climb the red-and-white lighthouse, then linger over dinner while rigging clinks and boats rock gently in the harbor.

About 30 Minutes Away

Sea Pines Forest Preserve

Boardwalks creak over still, dark lakes as Spanish moss sways from live oaks. A hushed, shady escape on a cool afternoon.

A Short Ferry Ride

Daufuskie Island

Feel the wind on the ferry across Calibogue Sound, then rumble down sandy lanes by golf cart past shell beaches and Gullah history.

About an Hour's Drive

Forsyth Park, Savannah

Stroll beneath Spanish moss to the splashing fountain, then wander Savannah's squares with a warm praline in hand.

Good to Know

Questions, answered

How far is Palmetto Promise from the beach?

About a 3-minute walk. You stroll past the pool and over the resort's private dune boardwalk to the sand. Beach chairs, an umbrella, a boogie board, towels, sand toys and a wagon are provided.

How many people does the condo sleep?

Up to 6, with a queen bed, twin bunks and a sleeper sofa. It's about 500 square feet, so it's most comfortable for 2 adults and 2 kids, and even that is cozy. Six is cramped, and the bunks fit kids or shorter adults.

Are the pools heated, and is there a hot tub?

The resort's two pools are open year-round, but they aren't heated or cooled, so winter swims are brisk. There is no hot tub.

Do you offer monthly winter discounts?

Yes. Monthly stays January through March are discounted. Hilton Head winters are mild and quiet, and the condo has 1 Gbps fiber Wi-Fi, a full kitchen and laundry on your floor for a longer stay.

What do I pay when I book direct?

Booking here goes straight to Lee and Kristina, who manage your reservation personally. A small processing fee still applies, and you see every charge before you pay. Damage protection up to $1,500 is included, with no security deposit.
